create.name: Yoga des Bains
create.bio:
Yoga des Bains is an Iyengar yoga studio in Geneva, on the first floor of a courtyard building on Rue Gourgas, offering classes since 2005. It is run by two Iyengar teachers. Alain Jean-Mairet came to yoga through books and travel in India and Nepal, found the Iyengar method in 1996 and trained in Bern before many study trips to Indian teachers. Dominique Zuni-Fornara met the method in San Francisco while working in software, studied at the Iyengar Yoga Institute there, completed her certification in Switzerland in 2010 and spent a month at the Pune institute the same year.

The room is set up with wall ropes and shelves of bolsters, blankets and other props. The weekly timetable covers general and level 1–2 classes, lunchtime sessions, a Zoom class and longer Saturday practices, paid by the class or with a ten-class card. The studio also hosts visiting teachers: senior Iyengar teachers for weekend intensives, and Marina Bergamin, who teaches traditional hatha yoga in the line of Acharya Venkatesha, for weekend workshops and a year-long practitioners' course.

courses.title: Horaires & Tarifs (weekly Iyengar classes)
courses.description: The studio's weekly Iyengar classes with Alain and Dominique, from lunchtime and evening sessions to a Zoom class and three-hour Saturday practices. Reduced rates apply for pensioners, students and the unemployed.
courses.price: Cours individuel CHF 30.-; Premier cours CHF 20.-; 10 cours CHF 250.- (AVS, étudiants, chômeurs: CHF 23.- / CHF 15.- / CHF 220.-)

courses.title: Week-end de Hatha Yoga traditionnel avec Marina Bergamin – 21-22 novembre 2026
courses.description: A weekend of asana, pranayama and concentration practice with the visiting teacher Marina Bergamin, a full Saturday and a Sunday morning in the Geneva studio. Single days and half days can also be booked.

courses.title: Formation du pratiquant 2027 avec Marina Bergamin
courses.description: A course of seven weekends through 2027 for practitioners who want to build an independent home practice, with a personal asana and pranayama sequence, guided meditation, chanting, mudra, yoga nidra and philosophy.
